prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE production icon atlas for Elements - Icons. The supplied image is a STYLE REFERENCE; replace its subjects with the subjects specified here.
Rustic, earnest old-fashioned COLOURED WOODCUT. Match the supplied references' warm black, dull ochre, clay/rust red, slate blue, muted olive and creamy carved cuts, but visibly simpler and less polished than the first reference: a small number of broad confident cuts, occasional knife slips, uneven angular contours, slightly crooked handmade things, thin missed patches in ink and colour plates shifted slightly beyond or short of their black outlines. Imperfect registration must look printed, not blurred. No smooth gradients, modeled digital shading, tiny decorative hatching, glossy highlights, outline stickers, cute toy proportions, circular badges, frames or presentation shadows. Humble functional objects, easily recognised at 56 pixels. Natural, clear silhouettes before texture. Transparent outside each object.
EXACTLY FIVE columns and FOUR rows, 20 equal cells, wide 5:4 atlas. Keep every complete subject centered in its own cell with at least 15% TRANSPARENT MARGIN from all cell boundaries; strict grid with clear wide gutters. No labels or numbering, no drawn grid, no text except where explicitly requested. Do not repeat objects from the reference unless listed. Make the states of related objects clearly different, using silhouettes and visible contents.
READING ORDER:
1. Inked printing block: Same rectangular carved wooden printing block with its boat/table printing face visibly covered in black ink
2. Letter: One folded cream letter with a simple rust-red wax seal, no readable writing
3. Flute: Plain long wooden flute with six clearly visible finger holes and an open end
4. Drum: Squat clay jar with a taut cream cloth skin tied across its wide mouth, two plain beaters
5. Bandstand: Low rectangular wooden stage with a cream canopy overhead on four posts, no instruments or puppets
6. Hollow tube: Short straight narrow smooth wooden tube with open ends, no finger holes, distinct from thick barked pipe
7. Platform: Low bare rectangular plank platform on four short supports, no canopy or curtain
8. Puppet theatre: Small wooden stage with rust-red curtains pulled apart and two simple hand-made puppets visible within
9. Picture book: Open cream book with simple large red flower and blue boat illustrations across its pages, no writing
10. Brush: Plain wooden-handled brush with a tuft of long plant-fibre bristles, no paint bowl
11. Puppet: One earnest simple wooden-and-cloth human puppet with dangling limbs, no huge cartoon face
12. Curtain: Two hanging rust-red cloth panels parted in the middle on a plain wooden rail, no stage
13. Stage: Low wooden platform with two hanging rust-red curtains, no puppets or canopy
14. Paint: Three small plain paint bowls, ochre red and slate-blue, with a short mixing stick
15. Picture: One unframed cream sheet showing a simple coloured river landscape, no book
16. Bound book: Closed plain brown cloth-bound book with visible stitched spine and cream page block, no cover picture
17. Pond life study: Cream study sheet showing three enlarged simple microscopic swimming organisms with one little blue sample drop, no labels
18. Microscope: Plain old brass-and-wood microscope, upright eyepiece tube, focus knob and clearly separate sample stage
19. Lens: One round pale-blue convex glass lens with thick curved edge, no handle or frame
20. Magnifier: Round pale-blue magnifying lens in a plain dark wooden ring with a short handle
Keep all twenty separate, complete and rustic.
